description.value:
Frequency once per week

Requirement You personally installed the bio-augment.

Cost 1 Vitae

Spend 10 minutes and 1 Vitae tending one bio-augment you personally installed, in yourself or an ally. Its Load contribution is reduced by 1 (minimum 0) until your next checkup. Skip a week and the reduction lapses at the start of the following week; you must re-tend it to restore it.
